prompt_policy: Contact only when right hand/fingers/palm visibly touches or holds the object; near/ambiguous is false.

decisions.reason: The right hand is near the scanner but there is a clear visible gap and no touching or grasping.
The person's right hand is away from the scanner with a visible gap; no touching or grasping is visible.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but remains visibly separated with a gap; no touching or grasping is shown.
The person's right hand is away from the scanner with a visible gap and is not touching or grasping it.
Right hand is reaching toward the scanner but remains visibly separated with a clear gap.
Right hand is hovering above the scanner with a visible gap and no clear physical contact.
Right fingers are close to the scanner but visible contact is ambiguous and no clear overlap or grasp is shown.
Right hand is very close to the scanner but clear physical touching is not visible; contact is ambiguous.
Right hand/fingers visibly overlap and wrap against the pink scanner, indicating physical contact.
The person's right hand/fingers visibly overlap and touch the pink scanner, appearing to grasp it with no visible gap.
